name: Camping Heiterwanger See Fischer am See
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Camping Heiterwanger See Fischer am See is located directly on the northern shore of the Heiterwanger See in the municipality of Heiterwang in Tirol. The area is characterized by the Ammergauer Alps and the Zugspitz region, offering numerous hiking trails and biking routes. The atmosphere is peaceful and deeply connected to nature. The facilities include campground pitches for tents, caravans, and RVs, sanitary facilities, electric hookups, water points, and a restaurant with a baker’s service. In summer, guests can swim in the lake or explore the trails for hiking and cycling. In winter, nearby ski resorts like the Zugspitze or Lermoos are easily accessible. The site serves as a perfect base for activities throughout the year.
